why_best: Grounding the feature inside a classic documentation console builds instant trust with technical buyers who value function over flashy visual effects.
why_bad: A sleek, glassmorphic UI overlay with heavy drop shadows would alienate senior developers by feeling like a marketing gimmick rather than a genuine working environment.
trap: Rushing the text reveal into an instantaneous block paste destroys the organic cadence that signals a live, thoughtful command line session.
